title: Appeal.
bodyText: In accordance with applicable rules of court, the defendant may appeal to the supreme court and intermediate court of appeals from an order denying a motion made pursuant to this part.
bodyHtml: [§844D-129]  Appeal.  In accordance with applicable rules of court, the defendant may appeal to the supreme court and intermediate court of appeals from an order denying a motion made pursuant to this part. [L 2005, c 112, pt of §1]
